tasks.title: two pure fns
tasks.objective:
[HARD] Write only Python, no markdown.

Implement two pure functions:

def add(a, b)   -> the sum of a and b
def mul(a, b)   -> the product of a and b
tasks.holdout_test:

assert mul(2, 3) == 6

assert mul(0, 7) == 0
print('ok')

tasks.title: class counter
tasks.objective:
[HARD] Write only Python, no markdown.

Implement:

class Counter
    Starts at zero. Its inc() method increments the count by one and returns the new value. The current value is readable as the attribute n.
tasks.holdout_test:
c = Counter()
assert c.inc() == 1
assert c.inc() == 2
assert c.n == 2
assert Counter().n == 0
print('ok')

tasks.title: pipeline normalize
tasks.objective:
[HARD] Write only Python, no markdown.

Implement two functions that compose:

def normalize(s: str) -> str   # strip surrounding whitespace and lowercase
def tokens(s: str) -> list     # normalize, then split on whitespace
tasks.holdout_test:
assert normalize('  Hi There ') == 'hi there'
assert tokens('  Hi There ') == ['hi', 'there']
assert tokens('') == []
assert tokens('ONE') == ['one']
print('ok')

tasks.title: scratch-style modules in one file
tasks.objective:
[HARD] Write only Python, no markdown. Simulate two modules in one file.

A util section:
def clamp(x, lo, hi)   # return x constrained to the inclusive range lo..hi

An app section:
def score(x)           # clamp x into the inclusive range 0..100
tasks.holdout_test:
assert score(-5) == 0
assert score(150) == 100
assert score(50) == 50
assert clamp(5, 1, 3) == 3
assert clamp(0, 1, 3) == 1
print('ok')
